title: Ruk Nahi Sakta Ye Matam Jhuk Nahi Sakta Ye Parcham
body:
Rukh nahi sakta yeh matam, jhukh nahi sakta yeh parcham, lehrate rahe isko jafar , kandha pa utaha te thay Hyder, saat iske rahi hai fath-o-Zafar, Abbas ke hataon mein aakar, kuch aur bada iska dum kham, rukh nahi sakta yeh matam, jhukh nahi sakta yeh parcham, yeh parcham-e-haq hai elhe aza, emaan ki hawa hai iski hawa, saye mein hai iske rahe khuda, yeh zulm ke haq mein shola hai, aur sabr ke haq mein hai shabnam, rukh nahi sakta yeh matam, jhukh nahi sakta yeh parcham, kuch khauf-o-musibath isko nahi, shamsheer ki hajath iskonahi, hataon ki zaroorat isko nahi, maidan mein jab yeh aata hai, tharrate hein is se zulm-o-sitam, rukh nahi sakta yeh matam, jhukh nahi sakta yeh parcham
Tum isko taharath se choona, izhaare aqidath se choona, emaan ki basaarath se choona, tatheer-e-badam bhi lazim hai
Haan iski ziyarath ko humdum, rukh nahi sakta yeh matam, jhukh nahi sakta yeh parcham, sholaon pa guzarta hai jab yeh
Kuch aur nikharta hai tabyeh, taqat se bikharta hai kab yeh, gulzaar banata jata hai, -sholaon ki ravish ko bhi paiham, rukh nahi sakta yeh matam , jhukh nahi sakta yeh parcham
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir ki nusrath hai matam, Zainab ki inayath hai matam, haan ajar-e- risalath hai matam, matam hi se ab tak zinda hai, islam ki azmath aye humdum, rukh nahi sakta yeh matam
Jhukh nahi sakta yeh parcham
Jab waris-e-Hyder aaye ga, , har simth yahi lehrayega, yeh sarey jahan pa chayegaa, ajayenge iske saaye mein, , jannat ki fiza se ehleharam, rukh nahi sakta yeh matam
Jhukh nahi sakta yeh parcham, tuba ki fiza hai saath iske , taayide khuda hai saath iske, zehra ki duwa hai saath iske, duniye ki koi taqat ho hasan, kar sakti nahin iska sar qam, rukh nahi sakta yeh matam, jhukh nahi sakta yeh parcham
